progression.narrative: The performance opens on D4 and dwells most on Ek in Kereshme. The line peaks at Fs4 (351.4 Hz) at 0:51.5. It closes on Ek3, not the tonic (C4 → Ek4 → Fs4 → Ek4 → Eb3 → Ek3).
